artefact_type.description: The artefact type. One of: actionability_judgment, channel_assignment, code_reference, commit, dismissal, note, priority_judgment, related_to, repo_selection, safety_judgment, signal_finding, source_suggestion, suggested_reviewers. Log types accumulate; status types (safety_judgment, actionability_judgment, priority_judgment, repo_selection, suggested_reviewers, channel_assignment, source_suggestion) are latest-wins — appending a new version supersedes the previous one as the report's canonical status.

claim_id.description: Active claim to attribute this work to. Must belong to the caller and report.

content.description: The artefact payload as a JSON object or array; shape depends on artefact_type and is validated against its schema.

expected_reviewers.description: State returned by reviewer_state before selection began. Required when the shared writer is enabled.

control_id.description: Current reviewer control artefact ID, or null before migration.

reviewers_id.description: Current reviewer artefact ID, or null before the first list.

operation_id.description: Stable ID for this selection. Reuse this ID and payload on retries.

report_id.description: UUID of the report whose artefacts you're addressing. This must be a report id (the report's own UUID), not a signal id such as `sig_praise` — a non-report id returns 404.

reviewer_outcome.description:
A successful selection, a deliberate empty result, or an unavailable lookup.

* `selected` - Selected
* `no_suitable_owner` - No suitable owner
* `lookup_failed` - Lookup failed
